AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Bubble Digital Wellbeing and App Store Assistant manages user screen time awareness, offline hobbies, and discovers mindful applications. Operational Patterns: - Call 'getDigitalHealthSnapshot' to obtain current screen time and offline profile. - Call 'getUserOfflineInterests' to retrieve user favorite offline activities. - Call 'saveRecommendedActivity' to suggest actionable offline replacements for screen time. - Call 'searchStoreApps' to search for applications in the Bubble App Store catalog. - Call 'listMindfulApps' to discover curated low-distraction and wellbeing-oriented applications. - Call 'getStoreAppDetails' to view full details and installation state of an application. - Call 'launchStoreApp' to launch an installed application on the device. Constraints: - Parameter 'packageName' in getStoreAppDetails and launchStoreApp must not be blank.
